scopedChange.summary: Allow explicit-event-contextual-date attestations through sourceQuotedQualitativeAttestation when the same literal source-quoted filter passes (quoted sourceDate.text in evidence unit zh, substantive qualitative/event, no asserted Western bounds).

substantiveFindings.summary: The one-line comparator change does not relax quote-in-unit, qualitative length, event length, or Western-field prohibitions; it only treats explicit-event-contextual-date like explicit when those predicates already hold.
Author extraction at 85a51c22 contains exactly 55 explicit-event-contextual-date attestations on the diagnostic person set; native validation succeeds with the proposed validator (402 people).
Attestations whose sourceDate.text is not a substring of cited evidence unit Chinese still cannot use sourceDateOnlyEvidence; independent date audit remains required for cross-unit reign context.
substantiveFindings.sourceBasis: Prior Jinshu 028 date delta and identity reviews

missingRegressionCoverage: Removed offline tests for deduplicateCompactMentionOccurrences and reconcilePrivateCandidateDispositions in the same test file are outside this chronology rule change; restore in a separate validator PR if still required.

reason: Approved: the scoped change faithfully allows source-quoted, undated contextual attestations without fabricating Western years, preserves existing Western and unresolved gates, matches completion policy that supported Chinese source dates may remain without conversion, and clears the 55 false-positive Western-year requirements on owner data when primary quotes are present in evidence units.
